MX Race Performance.

MXRP are a Sunny Coast based motocross performance specialist. As with most businesses, working on expensive performance bikes takes a certain level of trust from the customer. Daniel from MXRP needed a way to instil confidence in his work and his team to potential clients.

Personality, expertise and professionalism are best shown through video and so we set out to create a campaign for MXRP. As with most shoots, we also made the most of being on site and captured loads of high-resolution stills for MXRP to use on their website and social media.

It was a pleasure to capture Daniel and the MXRP team and we at Pepper look forward to working with them in the future!
